info.title: Sourcepoint Global Enterprise API
info.description: Sourcepoint Technologies API for managing property and end-user Global Enterprise information.

get.description: Returns end-user consent history. In addition to the `siteId`, you will also need to include <u>either</u> the end-user's `globalcmpUUID` or `authId`.

parameters.name: siteId
parameters.description: The property ID for the property in the Sourcepoint portal.

delete.description:
Deletes end-user Global Enterprise consent status for a property. In addition to the `siteId`, you will also need to include either the end-user's `globalcmpUUID` or `authId`.

This endpoint does not support mass deletions of end-user consent records. Please speak to your Sourcepoint representative to execute any mass deletions.

parameters.name: siteId
parameters.description: The property ID for the property in the Sourcepoint portal.

deleteConsentStatus.description: Returned response to delete consent status

getConsentHistory.description: Returned response to get consent history

items.description: Consent status entry for the given `dateCreated`

_id.description: Unique identifier for the consent record

dateCreated.description: The date the consent status was created/last updated.

uuid.description: Retrieved from`globalcmp` object in the `_sp_user_consent_{propertyId}` local storage item

privacyManagerId.description: Privacy manager ID. This property will be `null` if consent was given from the first layer message.

vendorListId.description: The Global Enterprise vendor list associated with the property

vendors.description: Vendors that have been opted into by the end-user. A vendor is considered opted into if at least one of the mapped privacy choices to the vendor is opted into.

categories.description: Privacy choices that has been opted into by the end-user

name.example: Sell or share my personal information / opt into targeted advertising

systemId.description: If available, a global ID that remains the same across all vendor lists for Sourcepoint-supplied privacy choices. Custom privacy choices do not have system IDs because they vary for each vendor list.

uuid.name: uuid
uuid.description: Retrieved from`globalcmp` object in the `_sp_user_consent_{propertyId}` local storage item

authId.name: authId
authId.description: Retrieved from the first-party cookie authId

latest.name: latest
latest.description: (Optional) Only return latest consent record for the end-user
